spellcasting: Main article: Spellcasting ability Some illithid powers involve saving throws . For these powers, the difficulty class is determined by your spellcasting ability modifier , even for classes that do not typically have spells. All bonuses to spell save DC such as Arcane Acuity or Arcane Enchantment will also apply to illithid powers. If multiclassing, the ability score used by this modifier is determined by the latest class added. In other words, taking level 1 in a new class will switch the spellcasting ability modifier used by illthid powers (and items or scrolls) to the modifier of the new class.

powers.name: Illithid Persuasion
powers.description: You can use your connection to the parasite in your brain to force cultists of the Absolute to obey you. Recharge: Long rest

powers.name: Psionic Overload
powers.description: Your attacks deal an additional 1d4 Psychic damage, but you take 1d4 Psychic damage every turn. Recharge: Short rest

powers.name: Favourable Beginnings
powers.description: The first Attack Roll or Ability Check you make against any target gains a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

powers.name: Force Tunnel
powers.description: Charge forward, pushing all objects and creatures in your path 4 m / 13 ft away from you. Recharge: Short rest

powers.name: Concentrated Blast
powers.description: Deal 3d6 Psychic damage. You must be Concentrating on another spell to cast this. If the target was concentrating, you heal as much as the damage that was dealt to it. The spell you were concentrating on will end. Recharge: Per turn

powers.name: Transfuse Health
powers.description: Sacrifice half your remaining hit points to heal a target for the same amount. Recharge: Per turn

powers.name: Stage Fright
powers.description: Your targets have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and take 2d6 Psychic damage each time they miss. Targets overcome their Stage Fright early when they succeed on an Attack Roll. Recharge: Short rest

powers.name: Ability Drain
powers.description: Once per turn, when you make an Attack Roll, the attack reduces that target's corresponding Ability by 1. The Ability that is reduced is the same as the one used to make the Attack Roll. Recharge: Per turn

powers.name: Luck of the Far Realms
powers.description: When you make a successful Attack Roll against a foe, you can change that attack into a Critical Hit. Recharge: Long rest

powers.name: Charm
powers.description: Channel the dark allure of the tadpole to Charm an enemy that attacks you, preventing them from attacking you until their next turn. Note: Enemies have Advantage on the Saving Throw against being charmed.

powers.name: Displace
powers.description: Creatures suffering Falling damage because of your actions take an additional 1d8 Psychic damage.

powers.name: Repulsor
powers.description: Push anything and anyone back 6 m / 20 ft. Deals 2d6 Force damage, targets take half damage if successful on save. Recharge: Short rest

powers.name: Psionic Backlash
powers.description: When an enemy within 9 m / 30 ft casts a spell, you can use your Reaction to inflict 1d4 Psychic damage to the caster per the spell‘s level.

powers.name: Cull the Weak
powers.description: When you bring a creature down to fewer hit points than your number of evolved illithid powers, it dies and all nearby creatures take 1~4 Psychic damage.

powers.name: Shield of Thralls
powers.description: Conjure a volatile shield around yourself or an ally, granting the target 10 temporary hit points. Recharge: Short rest

powers.name: Perilous Stakes
powers.description: Invest a creature with power that heals it when it attacks, but also makes it vulnerable to all damage. Recharge: Long rest

tiers.name: Elite powers
tiers.note: Upon first gaining access to illithid powers, the outer ring of abilities are locked. At the very end of Act Two , on the road to Baldur's Gate , the party is given the opportunity to unlock these powers by agreeing to absorb an Astral-Touched Tadpole and become a partial-illithid . Doing this automatically unlocks Fly (Illithid Power) and the 5 powers of the innermost ring: Concentrated Blast Favourable Beginnings Force Tunnel Psionic Overload , and Transfuse Health . Any regular Tadpoles the character might have already spent to unlock these abilities will be refunded. Absorbing the Astral-Touched Tadpole causes the character to undergo Partial Ceremorphosis and irrevocably changes their appearance: their eyes darken and their entire body covers with dark veins. [ 12 ]

powers.name: Fracture Psyche
powers.description: Invade a target's mind and disrupt its defences. The target's Armour Class is reduced by 1. If the target dies while its psyche is fractured, you can cast Shatter Psyche on another target. Recharge: Short rest
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Ability Drain Illithid Expertise

powers.name: Illithid Expertise
powers.description: You have deepened your sense of self, gaining Expertise in Persuasion, Deception and Intimidation checks. Also grants Proficiency in those skills if not already possessed.
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Luck of the Far Realms Fracture Psyche

powers.name: Psionic Dominance
powers.description: Use your Reaction to cancel a spell targeted at you if its spell level is less than or equal to your proficiency bonus. Recharge: Long rest
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Charm Black Hole

powers.name: Black Hole
powers.description: Summon a black hole that pulls in nearby enemies and potentially Slows them. Up to five more black holes can be summoned after first casting. Recharge: Short rest
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Displace Psionic Dominance

powers.name: Fly
powers.description: Fly to a target position. Consumes Movement Speed speed but not an Action or Bonus Action.

powers.name: Mind Blast
powers.description: Spew forth a conical wave of psychic energy and possibly Stun targets within. Deals 4d8+Spellcasting Ability Modifier Psychic damage. Recharge: Long rest

powers.name: Mind Sanctuary
powers.description: Sculpt a magical nexus that allows those within to take Actions and Bonus Actions interchangeably. Recharge: Long rest
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Psionic Backlash Freecast

powers.name: Freecast
powers.description: You have discovered a marvellous adaptability within yourself. Spell slots, charges, and similar resource costs for your next action or spell are removed. Recharge: Long rest
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Shield of Thralls Mind Sanctuary

powers.name: Absorb Intellect
powers.description: Gobble up a foe's intellect, lowering their Intelligence by 1 per turn and healing your wounds for 5 turns (1d8 Hit Points each turn). Recharge: Short rest
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Perilous Stakes Displacer Beast Shape

powers.name: Displacer Beast Shape
powers.description: Transform into a displacer beast that can Displace itself and enemies, and has 85 hit points. You take on the attributes of a displacer beast, but maintain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. When your displacer beast form drops to 0 hit points, you revert to your original form. Recharge: Long rest
powers.requires: Unlock one of: Stage Fright Absorb Intellect

tiers.name: Full ceremorphosis
tiers.note: During the final quest, Confront the Elder Brain , the player character will have the option to undergo full ceremorphosis and become a full-illithid . At this point, they will automatically unlock most illithid powers and gain access to more powerful versions of a select few. These abilities are not available through the "Illithid Power" screen, but are instead granted automatically after transformation.

powers.name: Strengthened Force Tunnel
powers.description: Charge forward, pushing all objects and creatures in your path 12 m / 40 ft away from you. Deals 3d10+4 Force and may cause Prone

powers.name: Fierce Perilous Stakes
powers.description: Grant an ally an additional 15 Psychic damage, automatic Critical Hit when they roll a 15 or higher, and healing on hit. However, they will also be vulnerable to all damage.

powers.name: Nebulous Black Hole
powers.description: Create a point of intense gravity dealing 3d10+4 Force damage and possibly slowing enemies.

powers.name: Synaptic Consumption
powers.description: Lower all of an enemy's ability scores by 5, then 1 per turn, and regain 2~20 Hit Points per turn for five turns. The foe is left Prone.

powers.name: Augmented Shield of Thralls
powers.description: Target two creatures, granting them 25 temporary hit points. Once these hit points are diminished, the shield bursts and leaves nearby enemies Stunned.

powers.name: Potent Concentrated Blast
powers.description: Deals 9d6 Psychic damage to an enemy. If they were Concentrating on a spell, heal an equal amount of hit points.

powers.name: Extract Brain
powers.description: Lobotomise a nearby creature that is Stunned, Prone, Sleeping, or Unconscious, dealing 5d10+50 Piercing damage and regaining 6d6 Hit Points.

powers.name: Tentacle Whip
powers.description: Deal 3d10+5 Psychic melee damage, and possibly Stun the target.

powers.name: Levitate
powers.description: Float to a destination using Movement Speed speed.

powers.name: Fracture Psyche
powers.description: Invade a target's mind and disrupt its defences. The target's Armour Class and Saving throws are reduced by 5. If the target dies while its psyche is fractured, you can cast Shatter Psyche on another target. Recharge: Short rest

powers.name: Permanent Mind Sanctuary
powers.description: Allows creature to take Actions and Bonus Actions interchangeably.

tiers.name: Other powers
tiers.note: These illithid powers are not part of the illithid power tree and are instead unlocked through story events.

powers.name: Survival Instinct
powers.description: Infuse a creature with psionic force. If it reaches 0 hit points, it regains 3d4 Hit Points instead of falling Unconscious. Recharge: Short rest
powers.requires: Reward from: Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite

powers.name: Awakened
powers.description: You can use all of your Illithid Powers as a Bonus Action. Your resistance to the zaith'isk in the githyanki infirmary awakened this power.
powers.requires: Succeed on all three saving throws when interacting with the Zaith'isk in Crèche Y'llek. Or, if Lae'zel is in the Zaith'isk, succeed on the final ability check.
